svg.aria-label: Falconet ArtVee in Vehicle Mode, converting, and in Siege Mode

g.text: Fights as a line tank. Tracks free, turret turning, combo gun on its autocannon breech.
One full turn. Engine power goes to the conversion gear. The tank cannot move or fire.
Locked down as a Thumper battery. The turret still turns a full 360 degrees.
